title: Starter access, patterns, personality, health history, referrals, reminders, cards, voices, search, and clearer pages
summary: Starter usage waits until used; patterns connect actions with next-day sleep; personality is editable in Settings or chat; blood-pressure history remains through source changes; referrals stay in the intended chat; reminders keep local time; workout rows and voice choices stay clear; managed search is current; the homepage starts lighter; and private Environment reports show shape while loading.
